lane.min_prominence_fraction.note: Lane peak prominence, as a fraction of the column profile's robust range.

lane.robust_range_percentile.note: 0.0 makes the lane scale exactly max-minus-min.

band.min_prominence_fraction.note: 0.001 is the nearest legal stand-in for switching this criterion off; the validator requires a positive fraction.

band.min_prominence_sigma.note: 0.0 switches the noise criterion off, which the validator does accept.

band.min_separation_px.note: Minimum spacing between band peaks within a lane.

band.baseline_percentile.note: Robust zero for a lane's row profile.

band.extent_relative_height.note: The ROI aperture. Selected on clean_mean_absolute_percent, not on band_f1.

band.extent_min_sigma.note: Noise floor under the ROI edge threshold.

background.local_median.window_px.note: Local-median window, with default.yaml's other parameters shipped.

background.rolling_ball.radius_px.note: Rolling-ball radius, with rolling_ball.yaml's other parameters shipped.

background.rolling_ball.presmooth_px.note: Mean filter applied before the ball is rolled.

shipped_configs.note: The two shipped configs as committed. They differ only in background.

matched_band_subsets.note: Matched bands of the shipped configs/default.yaml, split by the QC flags their ground truth carries. Not a parameter sweep; recorded in the same shape so the same checker covers it.

band_roi_sizes.parameter: band ROI extent, against the shipped 51 px median window
band_roi_sizes.note: Band ROI sizes over the dev split. `window_coverage` is the ROI area as a percentage of the local-median window area; a coverage of f means the median reports the 0.5/(1-f) quantile of the background rather than its median.

doublet_cost.note: What the 'one band per resolved maximum' ruling costs, split by the role and the band_shape cell of the truth bands it misses.

lane_roi_geometry.parameter: truth lane ROI width vs lane pitch
lane_roi_geometry.note: A detected lane ROI is one pitch wide and full height. Where the truth ROI is wider than a pitch, the quotient is the best IoU such a detection can score.

presmooth_variance.note: Variance reduction of a size x size uniform_filter with mode='nearest' on white noise, averaged over 500 realisations of a 192x256 field. The uncorrelated ideal is the sample count; the whole-image figure is below it because border pixels average fewer independent samples.

aperture_selector_uncertainty.note: Paired bootstrap, 2000 resamples of the 206 bands the whole sweep shares, seed 20260811. `difference_from_shipped_percent` is mean |error| minus the shipped 0.06 value's, on the same resample; its interval excludes 0 only where the ordering is resolved.
